description.zh: 预热文件上传方式，支持文本框和OSS方式上传。
description.en: The method of uploading prefetch files. Text box and OSS upload methods are supported.
The name of the scheduled prefetch task.

description.zh:
定时预热OSS文件，填入OSS的文件地址。
注意：OSS文件中是您需要预热的URL。
description.en:
The OSS file for the scheduled prefetch task. Enter the address of the OSS file.
Note: The OSS file contains the URLs that you want to prefetch.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can obtain it by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

description.zh: 需要预热的URL列表，文本框方式上传预热文件时使用。
description.en: The list of URLs to prefetch. This parameter is used when you upload prefetch files via the text box.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-scheduled-preload-job --insert-way oss --name example --oss-url https://xxxobject.oss-cn-reginon.aliyuncs.com/9d91_xxxxxxxxxxx_158bb6e0f97c477791209bb46bd599f7 --site-id 190007158391808 --url-list http://testurl.com/a.txt_http://testurl.com/b.txt --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreateScheduledPreloadJob --region cn-hangzhou --InsertWay oss --SiteId 190007158391808 --OssUrl 'https://xxxobject.oss-cn-reginon.aliyuncs.com/9d91_xxxxxxxxxxx_158bb6e0f97c477791209bb46bd599f7' --UrlList 'http://testurl.com/a.txt_http://testurl.com/b.txt' --Name example
